Is double sustain a must and is triple overkill?

She has NO synergy with discard at all

Saya just feels good because of the corrosion and discard draw lets you loop her short blade really well and her exalt will pop all of the corrosion

If your Saya already has a good home, skip, she can function without easily

To summarize

- Requires E2/3
- Hold Long Blade in Hand
- L if no Long Blade, use Defense to generate it
- Play Short Blade off rip (or whenever possible,) up to 3 times
- L once marked Gold, play Short Blade into Long Blade to combine and fuse into Whalefall
- L which in Turn, would also unlock your Exalt
- If incapable of using Exalt (or you want to use OE instead,) play Duel to use the Aliemus of her Allies to Battery herself
- Use Exalt / OE, only when you are guaranteed to die due to a lot of Damage

I would say triple sustain is overkill, because you can kind of screw yourself over with her if you're not careful

The second you prep her exalt you lose EVERY damage card she has, they all turn into draw and aliemus steal

Amplifies her exalt damage, but if you're not ready to kill them right that second, you shoot yourself in the foot
Just needs one at the very least
